run_f_synthesis: run f_synthesis to render a 3D face image from style codes with camera yaw and pitch
run_get_model: run get_model to load a pretrained StyleNeRF generator from a pkl checkpoint file
run_get_camera_traj: run get_camera_traj to compute a camera matrix from pitch, yaw, and fov parameters
run_check_name: run check_name to resolve a model name like FFHQ512 to its pretrained pkl path
run_set_random_seed: run set_random_seed to set both torch and numpy random seeds for reproducibility
